items.title: Alleged Member of “8-Digits Team” Ransomware Group Extradited from Italy for Role in Major Data Extortion Campaign Against U.S. Hospitals, Healthcare Entities, and Schools
items.summary: Roman Khlynovskiy, 43, a Kazak national, made his initial appearance in Knoxville, Tennessee, federal court today after being extradited from Italy to face charges for his alleged role in a ransomware and extortion conspiracy that targeted U.S. schools, hospitals, and healthcare entities.
